अंडमान तथा निकोबार प्रशासन
ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR ADMINISTRATION
सचिवालय / SECRETARIAT
****

#/texts/1.label: paragraph
#/texts/1.full_gt_text: Sri Vijaya Puram, dated the 20th July, 2026.

#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
In exercise of the powers vested in him under Rule 9 read with item
32(iv) in Part-II of the Schedule to CCS(CCA) Rules, 1965, the Chief
Secretary, A&N Administration is pleased to order the promotion of the
following Higher Grade Clerks to the Group 'B' (Non-Gazetted) post of Head
Clerk/Assistant In-charge in Level-6 (₹35,400-1,12,400) of the Pay Matrix
on regular/officiating basis, as indicated against their name, with effect
from the date of their reporting for duty to the promoted post:

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text:
On their promotion to the post of Head Clerk/Assistant In-charge/Assistant, they are entitled to exercise an option to get their pay
fixed in the promotional post in accordance with the provisions contained
under the Saving Clause of FR 22(1)(a)(1). The option shall be exercised
within one month from the date of reporting to the promoted post and the
option once exercised shall be final.
